candidates.description: This vector represents numerical values associated with hundreds and thousands, frequently appearing in financial, statistical, or measurement contexts.
This feature vector activates on names of historical American cities and towns, as well as common geographic suffixes and prefixes found in urban placenames.
These tokens represent three-digit numbers often associated with area codes, model numbers, or numerical data.
This vector is related to names of U.S. states.
This vector represents the months of the year in various spellings and abbreviations across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates strongly on words, prefixes, and stems starting with the German-derived character sequence "ver".
This vector represents common surnames or historical family names.
Geographic directions and regional or municipal place name components.
This vector represents proper nouns and place names, often associated with historical regions, titles, or geographic locations.
This feature vector represents German personal and possessive pronouns (along with some tokenizer noise).
